description: After an explicit customer request, validate exact known variants and prepare cart/checkout links. No cart is created until a link is opened. Never charge, place an order, guess sizes or claim quantities are reserved. No customer email, address or payment details accepted. The customer reviews and completes checkout.

customer_requested_cart.description: Only true after the customer explicitly asked to prepare these exact variants and quantities. Not payment authorization.
